p1: Every driver on Miller's Bridge knows about the woman in the white coat. Last night, she got in my car.
Every station on my radio was playing the same song. A song from 2006.
She never said a word. She just handed me a wet note. My mum's address.
At the next red light, I looked over. The seat was empty. Just a puddle.
So I drove there. Mum opened the door, and looked straight through me.
She whispered to the empty porch... Danny? Is that you?
On the wall behind her was my photo. Black ribbon. Miller's Bridge, 2006.
She isn't the ghost. She finds the drivers who never made it off that bridge... and takes them home.
Follow. And if she waves at you tonight, don't stop.
